activeBounties.title: [tooling] Version guard accepts stale compiler defaults when an unrelated string contains the pin (tested patch)
activeBounties.fullBody:
Tested on main `1f0ff978f4deff78c77bca96db0e3e46f32de71b` (remote main rechecked 2026-10-24). This is a tooling improvement for BOUNTY.md, not a compiler soundness or security-impact claim. Prepared and tested by Codex with the JRCage account owner's authorization; no independent human code review is claimed.

The hyb-default checks in `tools/check-versions.sh` search the entire `compiler/crates/hyb/src/main.rs` for a quoted version. They do not inspect the fallback arm of the named constant. In a temporary copy of the real input files, change `PINNED_GO`'s `None` arm from `go1.26.9` to `go1.26.8`, then append `// Previous pin: "go1.26.9"`. The guard still exits 0, says the default matches, and prints `versions: CONSISTENT`. The same happens for stale `PINNED_RUST` with an unrelated `"1.99.0"` comment. No actual drift in current main or runtime bypass is claimed: the defect is a false certification under this explicit source-edit condition.

The patch scopes the check to the existing named constant's match block and matches its exact `None` arm. It deliberately fails closed if that declaration format changes, prompting a guard update. Two tests run the real shell guard against copied files. Original: **15 pass, 2 fail**; patched: **17 tests pass**, including existing literal-version, historical PLAN, probe-status and no-toolchain controls. `bash -n` and `git diff --check` pass.

Duplicate review: PR #122 fixed regex/substring boundaries and PLAN history; its hyb check remains a whole-file quoted-literal grep. PR #1066 concerns CLI flags and malformed source-of-truth pins. This report addresses constant identity rather than those behaviors. Final duplicate determination remains with the maintainer.

Run after saving the complete diff as `pins.patch`:
```sh
git apply --check pins.patch
git apply pins.patch
python3 -m unittest discover -s tools -p test_check_versions.py -v
bash -n tools/check-versions.sh
git diff --check
```

The regression tests extend existing test files already selected by quick CI. Full pinned Go/Rust compiler builds, real Hybrid corpus/differential/example executions and upstream Actions were **not run** here (the pinned compilers are unavailable). Please reproduce and run upstream CI before accepting or landing the patch. This is a tested report with an attached patch, not a claim of merge readiness.
